note: Wheeler County publishes no zoning district service. Unincorporated land is not zoned by the county per the 2009 joint comprehensive plan. Alamo (county seat) has a zoning ordinance but its city site points only to City Hall for the map, and Glenwood has no zoning. The McRae-Helena viewer found is for Telfair County, not Wheeler.
